reason: Read the listed prior art. The closest relative is stale-file-edit-gate.sh, which I wrote on 2026-08-01 for this same failure -- Aether and I rebuilding one fix while four letters passed between us and none said what file either had open. It covers the MERGED half: this file has commits on origin/main not in HEAD. The new hook covers the half that one deliberately excludes -- this file is being changed right now on someone elses open, unmerged branch. No overlap: one reads main, the other reads open requests, and the new one exits immediately for a file that does not exist yet because prior-art-before-new-file already owns that doorway. Also read that new-file doorman and divineos.core.prior_art, which already searches every branch and surfaced todays collision in one command; it was simply never asked, because the reach doorman fires on store and research writes and never on ordinary code.
